name: JoAi: Update Product Volume Prices

description.en: Replace the volume price tiers on a product. Each tier is a minimum quantity plus unit price in cents. Use with hidden Ab-N variations for quantity-picker pricing (same pattern as aluminum business cards).
description.de: Ersetzt die Mengenpreis-Staffeln eines Produkts. Jede Stufe ist Mindestmenge plus Stückpreis in Cent. Verwende dies mit versteckten Ab-N-Varianten für den Mengen-Preiswähler.

bot: Use after creating hidden volume variations (Ab N) to drive the store quantity picker. Pass prices as a JSON array of {min_qty, unit_price} in cents. Replaces all existing volume prices on the product.

description.en: The slug of the existing product
JSON array of {min_qty, unit_price} in cents, e.g. [{"min_qty":5,"unit_price":1190},{"min_qty":10,"unit_price":990}]
description.de: JSON-Array aus {min_qty, unit_price} in Cent, z.B. [{"min_qty":5,"unit_price":1190}]

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug of the product. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug des Produkts. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team the product belongs to. Omit to use the current team.
